10 / Now · College Finale

Finally, College.

Four years. Countless deadlines, late nights, projects, and memories. College wasn't just about attending lectures and submitting assignments—I got to explore so much beyond the classroom. I served as Head of Design at AI Ignite Club, became Vice President of the GeeksforGeeks Community, led different teams, and even got the opportunity to present my research papers. Somewhere between managing people, building projects, making mistakes, and figuring things out, I grew more than I expected. And now, the black book, final project, presentations, and submissions are all done. One chapter, completed. So much more to figure out.
